cond_0090.intro:
We are looking for a Lead Finance Business Partner to join our Enterprise Business Partnering team at [Company name masked].
Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live. Help surface opportunities and share insight to support improvement initiatives and add value across the business.
Coordinate with relevant teams on financial risk management and the implementation and maintenance of controls.

Partner with business leadership in developing business cases and other strategic initiatives to help ensure that current and future investments align with business strategy and value requirements.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with [Location masked] Electric business leaders and teams, finance colleagues, and other internal teams.
Contribute to long-term business planning for capital projects, working alongside stakeholders across the business to connect activity and outcomes to financial investment levels.
Work with regulatory and finance colleagues to understand the regulatory structure of [Location masked] Electric operating companies (along with IFRS and GAAP accounting), supporting assessment of rate case changes, their application to decision making, and impact on future activities.
Coordinate with other FBPs on training and best practices to support efficiencies in activities and improved outcomes, contributing to continuous improvement.
cond_0090.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Broad range of financial, management and business modelling experience
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - proven track record in managing conflicting stakeholder interests.
Demonstrated critical thinking skills with an ability to identify key issues and recommend solutions to complex problems using data, logic and financial insight.
Strong commercial acumen and ability to influence and impact the decisions and financial performance of senior stakeholders and their teams throughout the relevant business area.

Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live. The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry.
To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business.
cond_0406.responsibilities:
The Lead Finance Business Partner supports the [Location masked] Electric organization and is responsible for providing commercial acumen, challenging strategic and financial priorities, and delivering financial guidance and insight to our [Location masked] Electric business partners to enable decisions that deliver financial performance. Focus primarily on operating expenses and capital expenses.
Support the business in developing and performance managing annual operating expenses and capital investments. Drive value in the business by exposing opportunities and insight to drive improvement initiatives. Manage financial risks and the implementation and maintenance of controls. Accountable for the [Location masked] Electric business monthly and quarterly performance results on operating expenses and capital expenditures with an emphasis on delivering insight and commentary on matters of importance and forward thinking financial and operational impacts. Partner with business leadership in the development of business cases and other strategic initiatives to ensure that all current and future investments are made in line with the business strategy and value requirements. Develop and maintain strong relationships with the [Location masked] Electric business leaders and teams, finance colleagues and other internal teams. Contribute to the long-term business planning for capital projects, working with stakeholders across the business, linking activity and outcomes to financial investment levels. Understand the regulatory structure of [Location masked] Electric operating companies (along with IFRS and GAAP accounting), collaborating with regulatory and finance colleagues on assessment of rate case changes, application to decision making, and impact to future activities. Collaborate with other FBPs on training and best practices to drive efficiencies in activities and improved outcomes, demonstrating continuous improvement.
cond_0406.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Broad range of financial, management and business modelling experience
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - proven track record in managing conflicting stakeholder interests.
Demonstrated critical thinking skills with an ability to identify key issues and recommend solutions to complex problems using data, logic and financial insight.
Strong commercial acumen and ability to influence and impact the decisions and financial performance of senior stakeholders and their teams throughout the relevant business area.
Experience in utility service business activities and systems a plus
cond_0406.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0406.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.

To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business.

Focus primarily on operating expenses and capital expenses.

Partner with business leadership in the development of business cases and other strategic initiatives to ensure that all current and future investments are made in line with the business strategy and value requirements. Develop and maintain strong relationships with the [Location masked] Electric business leaders and teams, finance colleagues and other internal teams. Contribute to the long-term business planning for capital projects, working with stakeholders across the business, linking activity and outcomes to financial investment levels. Understand the regulatory structure of [Location masked] Electric operating companies (along with IFRS and GAAP accounting), collaborating with regulatory and finance colleagues on assessment of rate case changes, application to decision making, and impact to future activities. Collaborate with other FBPs on training and best practices to drive efficiencies in activities and improved outcomes, demonstrating continuous improvement.

[Company name masked] delivers safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. The pace of change in our industry is accelerating, and our expertise puts us in a strong position to shape the sustainable future of energy delivery.
To succeed, we need to anticipate customer needs, reduce the cost of energy delivery today, and develop the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This means delivering on our commitments and finding new opportunities to grow.
cond_0565.responsibilities:
The Lead Finance Business Partner supports the [Location masked] Electric organization. The role is responsible for providing commercial acumen, challenging strategic and financial priorities, and delivering financial guidance and insight to [Location masked] Electric business partners to support decisions that deliver financial performance. Focus is primarily on operating expenses and capital expenses.
Support the business in developing and performance managing annual operating expenses and capital investments.
Identify opportunities and provide insight to support improvement initiatives and deliver value.
Manage financial risks and the implementation and maintenance of controls.
Accountable for [Location masked] Electric business monthly and quarterly performance results on operating expenses and capital expenditures, with an emphasis on delivering insight and commentary on matters of importance and forward-looking financial and operational impacts.
Work with business leadership on the development of business cases and other strategic initiatives to ensure current and future investments align with business strategy and value requirements.
Build and maintain working relationships with [Location masked] Electric business leaders and teams, finance colleagues, and other internal teams to support effective delivery.
Contribute to long-term business planning for capital projects, coordinating with stakeholders across the business to link activity and outcomes to financial investment levels.
Understand the regulatory structure of [Location masked] Electric operating companies (along with IFRS and GAAP accounting), coordinating with regulatory and finance colleagues on assessment of rate case changes, application to decision making, and impact on future activities.
Coordinate with other FBPs on training and best practices to drive efficiencies and improved outcomes, supporting continuous improvement.
cond_0565.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Broad range of financial, management, and business modelling experience
Demonstrated critical thinking skills with an ability to identify key issues and recommend solutions to complex problems using data, logic, and financial insight
Strong commercial acumen and ability to influence the decisions and financial performance of senior stakeholders and their teams
Preferred Requirements
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven track record in managing conflicting stakeholder interests
Experience in utility service business activities and systems

[Company name masked] delivers safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live. The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry.
To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business.
cond_0627.responsibilities:
The Lead Finance Business Partner supports the [Location masked] Electric organization and is responsible for providing commercial acumen, challenging strategic and financial priorities, and delivering financial guidance and insight to our [Location masked] Electric business partners to enable decisions that deliver financial performance. A large part of the role is staying in regular contact with business leaders and finance colleagues to align on priorities and drive performance. Focus primarily on operating expenses and capital expenses.
Support the business in developing and performance managing annual operating expenses and capital investments. Stay in close contact with business teams to expose opportunities and insight that drive improvement initiatives. Manage financial risks and the implementation and maintenance of controls. Accountable for the [Location masked] Electric business monthly and quarterly performance results on operating expenses and capital expenditures, with an emphasis on delivering insight and commentary on matters of importance and forward-thinking financial and operational impacts. Partner daily with business leadership in the development of business cases and other strategic initiatives to ensure that all current and future investments are made in line with the business strategy and value requirements. Develop and maintain strong relationships with the [Location masked] Electric business leaders and teams, finance colleagues and other internal teams. Contribute to the long-term business planning for capital projects, actively connecting with stakeholders across the business, linking activity and outcomes to financial investment levels. Understand the regulatory structure of [Location masked] Electric operating companies (along with IFRS and GAAP accounting), collaborating regularly with regulatory and finance colleagues on assessment of rate case changes, application to decision making, and impact to future activities. Collaborate with other FBPs on training and best practices, initiating discussions to drive efficiencies in activities and improved outcomes, demonstrating continuous improvement.
cond_0627.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Broad range of financial, management and business modelling experience
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - proven track record in managing conflicting stakeholder interests.
Demonstrated critical thinking skills with an ability to identify key issues and recommend solutions to complex problems using data, logic and financial insight.
Strong commercial acumen and ability to influence and impact the decisions and financial performance of senior stakeholders and their teams throughout the relevant business area.
Experience in utility service business activities and systems a plus
cond_0627.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
